title: Bouillot NDE 939
content: I fell into the river at the foot of a bridge. It was in summer and I had boots on. I couldn't swim. After a short panic underwater, I no longer felt my body and started to experience a feeling of happiness. In a moment that seemed very short to me, I reviewed the happy events of the life I had led. Then I was floating in a white light. Next, I had the feeling that I was asked very gently to make a choice between living or not living. I experienced that state of weightlessness as very pleasant. Then I regained consciousness because someone had dived in the water and had gotten me out. On the bank of the river I felt very cold.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes noyade Life threatening event, but not clinical death I was drowning.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.At what time during the experience were: I felt very lucid and happy.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes A white light engulfed me.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I saw in a very short time, like accelerated, the happy events of my life.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was five years old then, I had the feeling that I had to make a choice between living and not living, but I felt good, I didn't seem to have had a strong wish to get back into my body.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part was a feeling of happiness and absolute calm. The worst part was to be back out of the water.
